scope: Preserve independently checked publisher-authored map locators for Aligned and Rowan Bauxite in Frederick County, Maryland, without selecting construction status or WGS84 geometry.

identity.quantum_frederick: The state environmental agency distinguishes the approximately 2100-acre former Eastalco redevelopment from individual operators' smaller parcels. This parent redevelopment area is not interchangeable with each child campus.
identity.aligned: The separately labelled Aligned four-building parcel is distinct from Rowan's Bauxite parcels. The historical IAD06 topping-out record identifies a constituent of the Aligned campus; it does not create another physical site.
identity.rowan: The developer's Bauxite I/II/III portfolio describes one flagship campus. Its three named phases must count at most once, not as three physical sites. The map's western label is literally Bauxite, not Bauxite I; an independent identity bridge is required before using that marker for I.
identity.successor: The current undated Rowan portfolio reports Bauxite I substantial completion in 2025. Its 2026/2027 delivery language for II/III is prospective and is not selected as construction evidence. Bauxite I is not an eligible unfinished project on that evidence.

map.status_boundary: This is a map of approved site plans, not observed construction. Neither date establishes physical work. The broad CDI overlay outline is not a campus boundary; approved green polygons are not construction extents.
map.point_scope: Centers of publisher-authored purple labelled circle symbols, with leader lines checked visually on the complete rendered page. These are source-specific locators, not surveyed points, entrances, polygon centroids, building footprints or construction extents.
map.derivation: Read the PDF VP/Measure georeference. Transform the four NAD83 geographic controls into the publisher's exact projected WKT, fit an affine map from the local control coordinates by least squares, evaluate each vector symbol's bounding-box center relative to the PDF viewport, and inverse-transform to NAD83 longitude/latitude. Round to five decimal places, matching the controls. Do not silently substitute EPSG:2248: the source WKT has reversed equivalent standard parallels and a 0.0001016-metre false-easting difference.
map.independent_review: A separate reviewer inspected the full page and traced the leader lines, then independently solved a three-corner affine mapping using the exact WKT. All four main locators agree at five decimal places; the held-out fourth corner differs by 0.040325 metres. Those residuals measure computational consistency, not positional accuracy.
map.source_disclaimer: County map is illustrative and not for surveying, engineering or site-specific analysis.
